---
title: "Your first field note"
description: "Turn a small observation into a useful article."
author: "Example Author"
date: 2026-01-10
categories: [writing]
---

## Begin with one observation

Choose a question you can answer in a few paragraphs. Add enough context for
someone who has not seen your work, and finish with a concrete next step.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Keep the source readable

Use headings, short paragraphs, and descriptive links. A useful note does not
need custom JavaScript or an external dataset.
:::

## Publish the next note

Create another folder under `posts/` with an `index.qmd` file. Give it a title,
date, description, and categories so the article listing can organize it.
